lasttextenhun.title: Version SMARTview
lasttextenhun.body: Type Ver, Vers, or Version — capitals do not matter. BOT DEE shows the version card. A longer question like “what is your version?” still shows that card.

lasttextenhun.title: Version SMARTview status is a live probe
lasttextenhun.body: Service status is probed on this Version request: Functions and package reachable with Gemini configured → Operational; Functions and package up but Gemini not configured → Degraded; Functions not in this request → Unavailable. It is never a static Not checked label. AI model shows the configured Gemini model id for this deployment even when this turn did not generate. Frontend and backend package stamps can differ; both are labeled. Master Admin may see extra diagnostics after Technical Details — patrons do not.

lasttextenhun.title: Version SMARTview tabs
lasttextenhun.body: Overview describes BOT DEE and opens Technical Details without leaving chat. What's New lists verified BOT DEE and Gemini changes only — not Master Admin, beta tester tools, or other FLOQR product notes. Help repeats the Ver / Vers / Version command. Switching tabs or expanding details keeps your unsent draft and scroll. The card uses your Site Chrome — there is no second theme.
